releaseNotes:
Meals
- Plan every selected conference meal using the normal meal-planner layout, recipes, notes and cook assignments. Edits are shared between both planners.
- Conference meals automatically include other house guests present for the service, as well as named participants and additional unnamed day guests.
- Open the conference planner from the conference overview or a shortcut in the normal planner during its week.
- Print the full conference meal plan with its name, service times and counts, continuing onto additional A4 pages when needed.
- Clearer compact labels identify additional day guests in the conference meal setup.

Guest Inbox
- Sort folder messages by date, name or subject in either direction. Sorting covers the full folder and carries through filters and pagination; Sent sorts by recipient name.

Monthly
- Conference guest stays remain continuous when their colour changes at the conference boundary. Rounded edges mark stay boundaries, and orange applies only during conference days.
